description: This file defines the interface for managing a daemon process, including enums, structs, function prototypes, and callback types related to daemon lifecycle management, process control, and event handling.

methods.name: wld_dmn_setMonitorConf
methods.description: Sets the configuration for daemon monitoring, including enable parameter, restart limits, and interval.

methods.name: wld_dmn_initializeDeamon
methods.description: Creates and initializes a daemon monitor object for a given process and command.

methods.name: wld_dmn_setDeamonEvtHandlers
methods.description: Associates event handlers with a daemon process.

methods.name: wld_dmn_cleanupDaemon
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with a daemon process.

methods.name: wld_dmn_createDeamon
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a daemon process context with command, arguments, handlers, and user data.

methods.name: wld_dmn_destroyDeamon
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a daemon process context.

methods.name: wld_dmn_stopCb
methods.description: Callback to stop the daemon process.

methods.name: wld_dmn_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the daemon process is running.

methods.name: wld_dmn_isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the daemon process is enabled.

methods.name: wld_dmn_isRestarting
methods.description: Checks if the daemon process is restarting.

methods.name: wld_dmn_setArgList
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the argument list for the daemon process before start or restart.

methods.name: wld_dmn_setForceKill
methods.description: Forces the daemon process to be killed, using SIGKILL if necessary.
